items.title: Mailbox status says what actually works
items.detail: One rule (src/mailStatus.ts) using the server's readiness check: Working, Receiving only, No mail arriving yet, Not set up, Sign in needed. Problems show under the inbox name; Settings shows a badge with a hint.

items.title: All mail folder
items.detail: Every account and every tab in one list, archived mail too, never spam or trash. /mail/all, in the folder list and the phone switcher.

items.title: Sorting rules editor
items.detail: Settings, Mail: see what moving mail taught, change a sender's tab, remove it, or add a rule for an address or a whole @domain. Phone: rules listed in Inbox settings.

items.title: Shared inbox access levels
items.detail: Read, Reply, Manage per person; private inboxes hidden from admins.

items.title: Backup sign-in email
items.detail: So losing a company mailbox never locks you out of your other workspaces.

items.title: Chat summary: a simple brief you can refresh
items.detail: What's happening, what's urgent, what's decided, open questions. Simpler UI.

items.title: Home layout fully customizable
items.detail: Exact card sizes, more columns, add any card, balanced spacing (the customize bar touches the search field).

items.title: Bottom bar: margins, safe areas, rounded
items.detail: Floating bar with side and bottom inset, curves that follow the phone's corners, rethink labels.

items.title: Landing page audit and rewrite
items.detail: Say who it's for in the hero, two CTAs not three, agency and free guests up front, no endless marquee, consistent founder name, local mock names.

items.title: Brands inside a workspace
items.detail: Name, logo, colour, signature and sending domain per brand.

items.title: Domain step: connect or buy
items.detail: Sign up with any email, then connect your domain (buying is a later step).

items.title: One interface for guests and team
items.detail: Workspace switcher lists the workspaces you're a guest in.
